description: Which code does this Japanese municipality have on a date (default today)? Give a 5/6-digit code, or prefecture and name (old names OK). Returns status mapped / split_candidates / unknown / invalid, the valid code with English and Japanese names, change type and date (merger, incorporation, division, designated city, name change), confirmed JMA warning areas only, and J-LIS convenience-store certificate availability for 8 certificate types. Facts only, from e-Stat LOD (CC BY 4.0) and J-LIS.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD. The date the answer is for (default: today in Japan time).

code.description: Municipality code: 5 digits, or 6 digits including the check digit (e.g. 22131 or 221317).

name.description: Municipality or ward name in Japanese (old names accepted; a ward may be prefixed with its city) or its e-Stat English name (e.g. "Naka-ku", "Hamamatsu-shi"). Use with prefecture.

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture: English name (e.g. "Tokyo", "Osaka", "Hokkaido"; "Tokyo-to" and "Osaka Prefecture" also work), Japanese name in kanji, or JIS code "01".."47". Use with name.

name: jp_municipality

as_of_codes.description: Codes valid on as_of, with names, JMA area and J-LIS certificate availability.

input.description: The query as understood (code or prefecture and name, and as_of).

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Japan municipality code lookup
